summary.title: Build the BEST Chat App on Web | WhatsApp Clone | Flutter, Firebase, Riverpod Tutorial
summary.one_liner: A roughly 10-hour video walkthrough of building a WhatsApp-style chat app in Flutter using Firebase and Riverpod 2.0, from phone auth through messaging, statuses, groups and calls.
keywords: how to build a chat app with flutter
takeaways: How to set up a Flutter project and connect it to Firebase for iOS and Android.
How to implement phone number login with OTP verification and persist auth state.
How to manage app state with Riverpod, including an auth controller.
How to build chat features such as text, image, video, emoji, GIF, audio, replies and seen status, plus statuses, groups and video calls via Agora.
summary.summary: This is a long YouTube video tutorial by Rivaan Ranawat that builds a WhatsApp-style chat app with Flutter, Firebase and Riverpod 2.0. The chapter list shows it moves from project setup and Firebase connection through phone OTP authentication, Riverpod state management, and Firestore-backed messaging. Later sections cover media messages, audio, replies, seen status, statuses/stories, groups, and Agora-based video calling. The page text is mostly the chapter list and video metadata, so the exact code and details are not visible here.
